data.title: ZAWYA: Bahrain explores global tourism tie-ups
data.description:
By Staff Writer

Bahrain is stepping up international tourism co-operation and promoting the Gulf as a unified destination as the kingdom takes part in Arabian Travel Market (ATM) 2026 in Dubai.

Tourism Minister Fatima Al Sairafi highlighted the importance of closer government and private-sector co-operation to build a more resilient and competitive tourism industry during the event, which started yesterday and runs until Thursday at Dubai World Trade Centre.

Speaking during a high-level ministerial debate organised by UN Tourism, she said GCC integration offered a successful model for strengthening tourism resilience, traveller confidence and regional connectivity.

She noted that joint Gulf co-ordination had helped maintain travel flows and reinforce the region’s position as an integrated destination capable of adapting to regional and international developments.

The minister stressed that continued investment in infrastructure, innovation and human capital would be essential to sustaining growth, while joint promotion could further strengthen the GCC’s competitiveness on the global tourism map.

The debate, held under the theme ‘Building a Resilient Tourism Industry Through Collaboration’, brought together senior tourism officials and industry leaders, including UAE Economy and Tourism Minister Abdulla Al Marri and UN Tourism Secretary General Shaikha Al Nuwais.

Bahrain is showcasing its tourism offering through a 420-square-metre pavilion featuring 28 public and private sector entities, including the Bahrain Tourism and Exhibitions Authority, Gulf Air and Exhibition World Bahrain, alongside luxury hotels, resorts and destination management companies.

The pavilion is highlighting major tourism projects and initiatives, while bilateral meetings are being held with representatives from international markets to explore investment, co-operation and sustainable tourism opportunities.

The participation comes as Bahrain works to advance the objectives of its Tourism Strategy 2022-2026, with the kingdom seeking to attract more visitors and investment while strengthening its position on the regional and international tourism map.

On the sidelines of ATM, Ms Al Sairafi also met Mr Al Marri. They discussed ways to deepen tourism co-operation between Bahrain and the UAE and reviewed initiatives aimed at expanding the sector.

data.title: TotalEnergies, Mistral Partner to Develop AI Models for Reservoir Exploration, Engineering
data.description:
By Sarah Sloat

TotalEnergies and Mistral plan to invest more than 100 million euros ($115.5 million) in a program to develop frontier artificial intelligence models to support TotalEnergies in the exploration, characterization and development of oil and gas reservoirs.

The joint three-year program between the French companies will develop new AI models that can integrate, process and interpret large volumes of data to generate scenarios for developing exploration opportunities for TotalEnergies. It will also optimize and extend the life of existing projects, TotalEnergies said Tuesday.

As part of the program, TotalEnergies and AI startup Mistral will establish a joint scientific laboratory to develop solutions tailored to the French energy company.

Write to Sarah Sloat at sarah.sloat@wsj.com

data.title: FunRock signs agreement for two new games
data.description:
Fragbite Group AB’s (publ) subsidiary FunRock has signed a contract for the development of two new games. The contract entails expanding the partnership with an existing client for whom FunRock has developed a game that was recently successfully released.

FunRock has signed an agreement with an existing client for the development and customisation of two games under KovaPlay, its business unit for B2B Game Development. FunRock has previously delivered a game to this client, one that was released earlier this month and already showing promising results. The two new games will partially build on underlying technology and learnings from the first game, allowing for shorter development time with delivery planned at the end of 2026.

Remuneration consists of a fixed fee for game development and customisation, in combination with revenue share from revenue generated as a result of players transitioning from FunRock’s games to the operator’s iGaming content. The revenue share starts upon release and applies for as long as the games remain active on the client’s platform. The client is an iGaming operator currently growing its presence on the US market, utilising FunRock’s games to support player growth across multiple platforms.

“We are very happy to see an existing client expand their partnership with us following the successful release of our first game together. This is an important validation of both the product and our strategy: building games that create measurable value for our partners while developing long-term client relationships. The early results from the first game have been promising, and we are excited to build on that momentum with two additional titles,” says Magdy Shehata, CEO and Co-Founder, FunRock.

Similar to previous client projects under the B2B Game Development business unit, the two new games will function as retention tools to support player engagement and repeat play for the client’s iGaming platform. The games provide a layer that sits on top of the iGaming content, integrated but not itself iGaming games. The game product is a classic entertainment game which introduces a progression loop that in turn supports the revenue generation from the iGaming operator’s core content.

For questions, please contact:

ir@fragbitegroup.com

Phone: +46 8 520 277 82

About us

Fragbite Group AB (publ) is a Swedish corporate group based in Stockholm that creates long-term shareholder value through combining well-established business operations in Gaming and Esports with an ambitious, long-term Bitcoin Treasury strategy. Fragbite Group's oldest subsidiary was founded in 2002, while the group was formed in 2021 when the share was also listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market under the ticker $FRAG.

Email: lubor.gaal@circio.com

About Circio

Building circular RNA expression systems for enhanced gene and cell therapies

Circio Holding ASA is a biotechnology company developing novel circular RNA expression technology for gene and cell therapy.

Circio has established a unique circular RNA (circRNA) vector expression technology for next generation RNA, DNA and viral therapeutics. The proprietary circVec platform is based on a modular genetic construct designed for efficient biogenesis of multifunctional circRNA inside target cells. The circVec platform has applications in multiple therapeutic settings, including genetic medicine, cell therapy and chronic disease. It has demonstrated 75-fold increased RNA half-life and up to 60-fold enhanced protein expression vs. conventional mRNA-based viral and non-viral vector systems, with the potential to become a new gold-standard gene expression technology. The circVec R&D activities are being conducted by the wholly owned subsidiary Circio AB in Stockholm, Sweden.

data.title: BlincVision signs evaluation agreement in industrial automation
data.description:
BlincVision has signed an evaluation agreement with a Swedish industrial company. The evaluation will explore how BlincVision’s high-speed sensor technology can be used in industrial automation to improve production flows and strengthen quality control.

The customer is a Swedish industrial company with manufacturing operations in Sweden and Germany, supplying solutions to industries including automotive and defence. The company has developed its own AI-based solutions that use cameras to identify and classify different components. As part of the evaluation, the companies will explore whether BlincVision’s sensor technology can improve performance in the customer’s industrial applications.

“Industrial automation is an interesting area for our technology. The ability to quickly identify and analyse what is happening in a production flow can contribute to both higher efficiency and quality. Together with the customer, we now have the opportunity to evaluate our technology in a real industrial environment and see where it can create the most value,” says Markus Johansson, CEO of BlincVision.

The evaluation is part of BlincVision’s work to expand the use of its technology across different markets and applications.

For more information, please contact:

Markus Johansson, CEO

E-mail: markus.johansson@blincvision.com

About BlincVision AB (publ)

The company develops the groundbreaking sensor solution BlincVision. The solution enables vehicles and machines to react earlier in high-risk situations. The technology focuses on relevant changes in the field of view, allowing faster detection. The ambition is to contribute to increased safety in environments where rapid decisions are critical, from urban traffic to applications within autonomous mobility, defense and industry.

BlincVision is headquartered in Lund, Sweden, and also operates in Gothenburg.

The company is listed on Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market.

Follow our journey at blincvision.com.
